title: Authorized Outcome evidence makes the positive curator_auto path reachable

given.candidate: an active-Plant raw standard photo candidate still in candidate state
given.outcome: a newly recorded follow-up Outcome whose authorized evidence_refs contain that photo source
given.curator: a fresh Training Data Curator run returning selected

when.association: record_follow_up_outcome invokes associate_follow_up_evidence in the same UoW and adds the Outcome ref
when.gate: the current-run selected advisory and curator_auto transition execute under current locks

then.evidence: the candidate has at least two refs of distinct kinds including follow_up_outcome and follow_up_seen=true
then.transition: candidate_status=confirmed, confirmation_source=curator_auto, quality_tier=standard, and can_train_on=true commit atomically
then.authority: no MessageEnvelope, Safety, Bus, UI, gold, caller-selected association, or stale curator selection contributes authority
